title: Wrap third-party font crates that can panic in catch_unwind
rule: When fm-core hands font bytes to a third-party crate that uses expect/unwrap or slice indexing on font data (skera, wuff, encoders, rasterizers), run the call inside `std::panic::catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(..))` and map a caught panic to an FmError (or Health::Broken). Add a test with a mutated fixture (for example a table removed) that reaches the panicking path and asserts the error.
rationale: E20.2 (#138): `subset::cut` called skera's Plan::new without a guard; a font with `loca` but no `glyf` made skera `expect` and crash the export instead of failing that face.
